sources.subject: A quick call
sources.text: I can do a ten-minute call Tuesday at 2pm or Thursday at 11am. Which works for you?
sources.action: Ask for the time zone before choosing a slot.
sources.draft: Hi Mara, thanks for offering Tuesday at 2pm or Thursday at 11am. Which time zone are those in?
sources.human_check: The source gives two times but no time zone. Nothing is booked.

sources.subject: Label correction
sources.text: Please change the label text from “12 oz” to “10 oz.” Please confirm before anything goes to print.
sources.action: Send the requested wording change to the print owner for review before confirming it.
sources.draft: Thanks, Ellis. You’ve requested a change from “12 oz” to “10 oz.” I’ll check it with the print owner before confirming.

sources.subject: Delivery window
sources.text: Delivery is now set for Friday, 10am–noon, at your studio. No reply needed unless the timing has changed.
sources.action: Keep the delivery window for reference. Jo only needs a reply if the timing has changed.
sources.draft: Thanks for the update about Friday’s 10am–noon delivery.
